title: Dead Zone
text: Provide region of zero output, 1 input, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Start of dead zone} sets the lower bound of the dead zone, {End of dead zone} sets the upper limit of the dead zone, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Treat as gain when linearizing} sets the gain value and {Enable zero-crossing detection}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Start of dead zone
params.values: Specify the lower bound of the dead zone ’-0.5’ (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: End of dead zone
params.values: Specify the upper limit of the dead zone ’0.5’ (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action on (default) | off

params.name: Treat as gain when linearizing
params.values: Specify the gain value on (default) | off
